summary: Implementation plan for the FC 27 UT App features prototype, including the Club Sync Modal JSON backup export (Blob with application/json MIME type and timestamped filename), dedicated AI Tactical Director prototype with tiered Gemini model routing (gemini-4-argon, gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.5-transcribe, gemini-3.8-live), and an interactive Three.js 3D photorealistic stadium pitch visualizer with procedural card totems.
